title: Pesto Sauce
description: A vibrant Italian basil sauce — fresh, aromatic, and utterly delicious. Pure summer in a bowl.

method.instruction: Place basil, pine nuts, garlic, and Parmesan into a food processor or blender.
Pulse while slowly drizzling in the olive oil until the mixture reaches your desired consistency — smooth or slightly chunky.
Season with salt and pepper to taste. Pulse briefly to combine.
Use immediately or store in the refrigerator with a thin layer of olive oil on top to prevent browning.

notes.title: Serving Tip
notes.content: Toss with hot pasta, spread on bruschetta, or use as a marinade for chicken or fish. Stir through scrambled eggs or roasted vegetables.

notes.title: Storage
notes.content: Keep refrigerated for up to 1 week with a thin layer of olive oil covering the surface to prevent oxidation. Freeze in ice cube trays for easy portions.
